topic: What Google AI Mode Actually Changes

primary_sources.title: A new era for AI Search (Google Search I/O 2026)
primary_sources.author: Elizabeth Reid, VP of Search

primary_sources.title: Google I/O 2026: Sundar Pichai opening keynote
primary_sources.author: Sundar Pichai

verified_claims.claim: Gemini 3.5 Flash is the new default model in AI Mode globally, starting May 19, 2026.
AI Mode surpassed 1 billion monthly users; queries more than doubled every quarter since launch.
AI Overviews has 2.5 billion monthly active users (Pichai keynote).
Search box redesigned — biggest upgrade in 25+ years; multimodal inputs (text, images, files, video, Chrome tabs).
Follow-up from AI Overview into AI Mode is live worldwide on desktop and mobile.
Information agents monitor the web 24/7; launch summer 2026, first for Google AI Pro & Ultra subscribers.
Generative UI in Search (Antigravity) — free for everyone, rolling out summer 2026.
Custom dashboards / mini-apps in Search — coming months; Pro & Ultra US first.
Personal Intelligence expanded to ~200 countries, 98 languages — no subscription required.
Agentic booking expanded (home repair, beauty, pet care call businesses); US summer 2026.

not_claimed_by_google: Google did not announce removing traditional search results or blue links entirely.
Information agents and persistent mini-apps are not live for all users on day one.
Personal Intelligence requires opt-in connection of apps like Gmail — not automatic.
